messages:
Rina (Product): Thanks for the candid answers in the Q&A. Couple quick clarifications folks asked for: 1) where to bias investment among Hosted/Dedicated/Private this fiscal year, 2) a one-line sales signal for when to push Dedicated, 3) a tight positioning blurb vs cloud AI platforms and self-hosted runtimes.

Jordan (CEO): Short answers: mission unchanged 7 make inference predictable and economical. Investment bias: Hosted = primary (PLG + velocity), Dedicated = focused for mid-market/enterprise monetization, Private = target for regulated/strategic deals. All tracks get runway but we shift incremental hires to Hosted.

Owen (Engineering): Clarify: does Hosted-first mean freeze on Dedicated feature work? Need planning guidance.

Jordan (CEO): No freeze. Keep Dedicated stability and SLA workstreams moving. New feature cadence will be staggered so Hosted gets faster iteration.

Leah (Sales): For the sales playbook: what's the one-line trigger to pitch Dedicated? Spend? QPS? Compliance?

Jordan (CEO): Working trigger: sustained spend > $25k/month OR sustained peak QPS above shared pool SLOs OR explicit security/compliance requirement. RevOps will finalize numbers.

Rina (Product): Positioning vs competitors  what's the concise blurb to use?

Jordan (CEO): Use: "Redwood provides a unified, high-performance inference runtime across hosted, reserved, and private deployments, delivering predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and enterprise controls without rebuilding your stack." Tailor tone for devs vs execs.

Leah (Sales): Perfect. I'll add developer-and-CIO variants to the playbook and share for a quick review.

Owen (Engineering): Action items for Eng: we'll propose SLO targets (p50/p95, cold-start, cost/token) for Hosted/Dedicated parity by end of week.

NoteBot: All-hands recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2365101234  notes in drive.

Rina (Product): Thanks everyone. Drop follow-ups here or DM me.
